book: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
title: Dinner at the Beavers’
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 7, the Beavers make the children a warm dinner. Build the Beavers’ dinner, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is the Beavers’ snug little house on the dam, from Chapter 7. Fish, potatoes, butter and a sticky marmalade roll!

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **fire** down first. Put the **rocking chair** beside it. Put the **table** near the fire and the **pot** on it. Put the **net** nearby.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “The Beavers help the children because ___. Edmund is quiet because ___.”
steps.text: Point to the table and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to the table and say this out loud. The Beavers help the children because… Edmund is quiet because…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the fire, the rocking chair, the table, the pot and the net

extra.text: Add a **Medieval Hatchet**. Say how Mr. Beaver used it to get fish.

points: Your photo shows the fire, the rocking chair, the table, the pot and the net.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each sentence and decide: is it in the book, or not? Then finish two sentences about Aslan and Edmund.
mapday.miss: Not quite. Think back to Chapters 7, 8 and 9.
mapday.done: ✓ You sorted every sentence. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A snowy wood with a spot for In the book and a spot for Not in the book

clues.q: Mr. Beaver catches trout through a hole in the ice.
Peter helps Mrs. Beaver catch the fish.
Mrs. Beaver is working at her sewing machine.
The Beavers’ house has a shelf full of books.
Dinner ends with a sticky marmalade roll.
Mr. Beaver says Aslan is a tame, safe lion.
Edmund slips away to find the Witch.
Edmund draws a mustache on a stone lion.

hints: he wanted to be a king
